title: CustomerQualityOutput
description: Anomaly-rule outcome envelope decoded by the cleaner's ToolAnomalyRule adapter.

quality.description: Quality tag attached to the L2 row when outcome=flag. Free-form short string; conventionally one of Ok/Spike/Stuck/NaN, but extensions may use bespoke values.

note.description: Optional human-readable note merged into the L2 row's `tags` JSONB under `{ <rule_id>: <note> }`.
